items.title: Alan Raph interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: But that’s how I met Mary Ann and we started going out together and ultimately got married.

ctx.x: It’s paid off insofar as it gives me a little credibility as far as knowing what I talk about educationally and instrument wise and all of that. I have a number of publications on the market, mostly through Carl Fisher, and in writing my bio in the books I’m able to naturally state that I have this degree and that degree, which means a lot with a lot of teachers. I also developed the vocabulary in taking education degrees to reach students a little bit better than I might have otherwise. It was just — that was…
she was the only student. They let her take the class. So naturally one thing led to another and we’ve been married now 23 years.
